title: Enforce Directory role rules; replace chatspace role with spaceId
description: 566c2b6/020da7f, draft lines 404-416, 1055-1068: a role is unique per account (invalidProperties), changing role needs mayRename, a Directory with a role cannot be destroyed/renamed/moved (forbidden) until cleared. Crate gates only chatspace (filenode.rs:1053-1113). crate-jmap-chat-filenode-server lib.rs:122,151,223,356,470 sets role 'chatspace' on every Space root and caps one root per Space (:150-160); tests/filenode_tests.rs:3585-3587 creates two chatspace roots in one account, which -20 forbids. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00.md:133 already identifies Space roots by spaceId alone (zero or more roots). Drop ChatSpace (crate-jmap-filenode-types filenode.rs:77) and key on space_id.
